definition: Neuronal regeneration is the repair or regrowth of damaged neurons, including renewed neurite outgrowth. In the central nervous system, this process can be blocked by factors such as reticulon-4 (Nogo), which inhibits neurite growth.

provenance.scope: Source record C97942; pinned source text

reasons: The packet does not define “neuronal regeneration” as the general repair or regrowth of damaged neurons; it only mentions that reticulon-4 may prevent neuronal regeneration and that atinumab may facilitate regeneration of damaged neurons.
The packet supports neurite outgrowth in relation to atinumab (stimulating neurite outgrowth), but it does not explicitly define neuronal regeneration as “including renewed neurite outgrowth.”

While the packet supports that reticulon-4 (Nogo) inhibits neurite outgrowth and may prevent neuronal regeneration in the central nervous system, the definition’s framing of a general CNS “process” being blocked by factors such as reticulon-4 is only partially supported (specific to reticulon-4 as an inhibitor, not as a broadly described mechanism of neuronal regeneration).
